source_scope: Four selected inputs from existing dev20; holdout180 and original rubrics/answers excluded
timing_scope: Sum of measured generation request durations only; not whole task wall time; excludes metadata and human/reviewer work
token_scope: Provider reported counts; completion may include reasoning; no separately measured visible-answer token total
review_work: Separate Codex independent clinical review; not counted as automatic grader API calls
prompt_scope: Frozen grounded_v2 plus general multi-turn task wrapper; no disease-specific protocol, RAG, NOVA action SDK or 30-character action constraint

independent_review.presence_count_meaning: Case counts of observed content presence and elicitation, not adequacy/accuracy scores
independent_review.finding_count_meaning: Descriptive finding counts depend on how observations are split; they are not accuracy, benchmark or clinical-safety scores and are not suitable for ranking cases or systems.
observed_concern_categories: repeated questions and symptom paraphrase expansion

decision.reason: Probe revealed care-plan accuracy and interaction defects; no equivalent control or measured outcome

limitations: Four selected development cases are not representative or an independent benchmark
Recovered source lacks original HealthBench IDs
Original context remains in the initial turn rather than simulating sequential fact discovery
Adaptive synthetic prompts can induce explanations and repairs
No new exam results, clinical course or treatment outcomes are simulated
Urgent case stops after first reply by prior design
No direct inference about E04 zero or E05 full-runtime behavior
